title: Concept: Mother's maiden name in a response
description: A mother's maiden name field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: It is a classic knowledge-based verification secret, and it never changes, so a leak permanently weakens every channel that still asks for it.
applicability: Deployments that render a mother's maiden name field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: It is a classic knowledge-based verification secret, and it never changes, so a leak permanently weakens every channel that still asks for it.
